description.value:
The Nekomata requires care, regular service and time to learn how best to use it. But it's really, really worth it. This electromag sniper rifle is a technological marvel. The tungsten spike it launches can pierce the thickest armor and walls, and shatter titanium bones. No one is safe from the Nekomata's destructive force, which is why the sale of this rifle is strictly regulated. It's almost impossible for mercs outside the employ of a government or major megacorp to get their hands on one... almost.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild is capable of seeing simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover. While Charged, this weapon can fire through up to one layer of Thin Cover or Thick Cover and, whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP.

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
